name: premium-light-classic-razorpay
changes: Rebuilds customer, listener, admin, legal and calling surfaces in a premium artistic light theme with no active dark-theme presentation
Preserves the confirmed working Razorpay Standard Checkout popup flow from v8.9.3 without callback or redirect payment navigation
Uses transparent auto-hiding headers that return on upward scroll or at the top, with high-contrast back navigation
Simplifies the listener experience and wallet to balance, per-minute rate, saved UPI/phone, amount and withdrawal request, with payout details edited in an on-demand popup
Keeps the admin-managed daily shuffled public listener image pool for customer and listener preview areas
Refines the customer wallet with a more prominent balance and tall premium plan cards: two per row on phones and up to five on desktop
Hides visible page scrollbars and removes decorative scrolling/transition motion while preserving normal page scrolling
Bumps project, PWA cache and asset versions to 8.9.5
